name.zh: 蝎尾狮号：尼奥克斯边境

author: fireStartZero

description.en: A fan tribute to Galaxy on Fire 3: Manticore, told with GoF2's art. Join Bryce Vantok's mercenary carrier in the lawless Neox frontier and take the first step of the hunt for the Gr'Gath warlord Sh'Gaal. The opening chapter: a new pilot in hangar 18, an escort at Phoenix Station and the first Gr'Gath boss. Story paraphrased, not GoF3's own text.
description.zh: 一份《银河火焰3：蝎尾狮号》的同人致敬，用 GoF2 的美术重新讲述。加入布莱斯·万托克的雇佣兵航母，在无法无天的尼奥克斯边境，迈出追猎格尔加斯军阀希加尔的第一步。开场章节：18号机库的新飞行员、凤凰空间站的护航，以及第一个格尔加斯头目。剧情为转述改写，非 GoF3 原文。

credits: Story after Galaxy on Fire 3: Manticore (Fishlabs / Deep Silver), retold in our own words. Uses only the assets of the Galaxy on Fire 2 remake.
